gloss: to see through; to foresee; to see all the way

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {見通|みとお}しませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {見通|みとお}していなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {見通|みとお}していませんでした

definitions.gloss: to see through; to see all the way to the end
definitions.explanation: To be able to see from one point to a distant point without obstruction. Used for long straight roads, clear views, etc.

definitions.gloss: to foresee; to predict; to see through (a plan or intention)
definitions.explanation: To anticipate a future outcome or to perceive someone's hidden intentions or the true nature of a situation.

examples.japanese: {真|ま}っすぐな{道|みち}が{遠|とお}くまで{見通|みとお}せる。
examples.english: You can see all the way down the straight road.

examples.japanese: {霧|きり}が{濃|こ}くて{前方|ぜんぽう}が{見通|みとお}せない。
examples.english: The fog is so thick that I can't see ahead.

examples.japanese: {天気|てんき}がよければ{海|うみ}の{向|む}こうまで{見通|みとお}すことができる。
examples.english: On a clear day, you can see all the way across the ocean.

examples.japanese: {将来|しょうらい}を{見通|みとお}す。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{市場|しじょう}の{動|うご}きを{的確|てきかく}に{見通|みとお}していた。
examples.english: She had accurately foreseen the market movements.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}は{生徒|せいと}の{嘘|うそ}をすべてお{見通|みとお}しだった。
examples.english: The teacher saw through all of the student's lies.

notes:
{見通|みとお}す has both a literal meaning (seeing through to the end of something) and a figurative meaning (foreseeing or seeing through deception).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)

ASPECT (ている):
{見通|みとお}している indicates a state of having foreseen or seen through something.

NOUN FORM — {見通|みとお}し:
The noun form means 'outlook' or 'prospect' and is extremely common:
- {見通|みとお}しが{明|あか}るい: the outlook is bright
- {見通|みとお}しが{暗|くら}い: the outlook is grim
- {見通|みとお}しが{立|た}たない: no prospect in sight
- {見通|みとお}しが{甘|あま}い: the forecast is too optimistic

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {将来|しょうらい}を{見通|みとお}す: foresee the future
- {先|さき}を{見通|みとお}す: look ahead
- お{見通|みとお}し: 'you see right through me' (polite, often humorous)
